customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam

While the sequence is unclear: Yesterday dark water came up through the floor drain again; The manager sent only a cleaner; My photos have no timestamps, and we went to the pharmacy about my daughter's rash; I cannot safely say more.

Regarding “repeated sewage backflow with an alleged health effect and uncertainty about what is causing it”, for today's submission: the backflow source remains unresolved; for the request “arrange immediate containment and specialist inspection, then assess a repair deadline, official deposit, and documented costs”: some dates are not yet in a reliable order; on “repeated sewage backflow with an alleged health effect and uncertainty about what is causing it”, I need a concise assessment first; also unresolved: the contamination extent; these points make up my first report.

This leaves me requesting: arrange immediate containment and specialist inspection, then assess a repair deadline, official deposit, and documented costs; in particular, I need clarity about the contamination extent and which dates reliably establish the chronology.

I need the chronology checked; What matters most is the backflow source; I can then plan how to proceed.

My first note about it is dated 15 June 2025.

Kind regards
customer_message.subject: Dates still need confirmation: repeated sewage backflow with an alleged health effect and uncertainty about what is causing it
